sections.text_helper: Section 27.1 "AES introduction" in chapter 27 (AES hardware accelerator (AES)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 793.
sections.section_content:
The AES hardware accelerator (AES) encrypts or decrypts data in compliance with the
advanced encryption standard (AES) defined by NIST.
AES supports ECB, CBC, CTR, GCM, GMAC, and CCM chaining modes for key sizes of
128 or 256 bits.
AES has the possibility to load by hardware the key stored in SAES peripheral, under SAES
control.
The peripheral supports DMA single transfers for incoming and outgoing data (two DMA
channels are required).
